item.title: clean code
item.description:
what is clean code

  • at low level:
  1. simple (no duplication, minimal number of classes, minimal dependency and API),
  2. direct and expressive.
  • at implementation level:
  1. TDD (unit and dependency test are always there)
  • at philosophical leve:
  1. is full of crisp abstraction
  2. straightforward lines of control

object and data structure

Objects hide their data behind abstractions and expose functions that operate on that data. Data structure expose their data and have no meaningful functions.
